questions.q: Which island has a 1 in 600 chance of living to 100?
questions.why: Sardinia is noted for its high centenarian rate.

questions.q: What does a Danish twin study say about genes and longevity?
a: Genes account for only 25% of longevity
questions.why: The study found genes only account for 25%.

questions.q: Which beverage do Loma Linda residents drink daily?
questions.why: They drink at least 5-6 glasses of water each day.

questions.q: What lifestyle habit helps centenarians avoid late-night snacking?
a: Eating early and stopping before fullness
questions.why: They stop eating before feeling full.

questions.q: Why do centenarians continue working past retirement age?
questions.why: Continuing work keeps a sense of purpose.
